observations: All five sheets reviewed. Twenty-nine cases show bottle tilt over the receiving cup and upright set-down. The final localization-rejected case retains the starting bottle/cup configuration. Four small underfills are determined from particle measurements; these still views cannot reliably resolve a sub-percentage-point height difference.
video_check: Videos encoded from actual synchronized recordings; selected source frames and stop/final views inspected. No claim of frame-by-frame inspection of every video.
limitations: Rendered surfaces and camera views are visual evidence, not calibrated physical liquid volumes; transient particle classifications remain in the quantitative report.
